item.title: Was Justice Really Served In Heather Elvis's Case?
item.description: Twenty-year-old Heather Elvis disappeared after a secret relationship with a married man, sparking one of South Carolina's most closely watched investigations. While convictions were secured, Heather has never been found, leaving many to question whether justice was ever truly served.

item.title: She Stole His Identity After He Disappeared
item.description: Larry McNabney vanished after a horse show in 2001, leaving behind a trail of unanswered questions. As investigators searched for the missing attorney, they uncovered an elaborate scheme involving his employee, Laren Sims, stolen identities, forged documents, and a murder that shocked everyone involved.

item.title: How Did Oakley Carlson Vanish Without Anyone Noticing?
item.description: Five-year-old Oakley Carlson disappeared from her family's Washington home, but authorities weren't alerted until more than a year later. As investigators uncovered allegations of abuse, suspicious timelines, and conflicting stories from her caregivers, the search for Oakley became one of America's most disturbing unsolved child disappearance cases.

item.title: The Killer Was Caught On Camera But Never Found
item.description: Elizabeth Barraza was setting up for a garage sale outside her Texas home when a disguised gunman approached and fatally shot her in broad daylight. The entire attack was captured on surveillance video, yet despite years of investigation, the killer's identity and motive remain a mystery.

item.title: Did Amanda Antoni Fall Down The Stairs Or Was It Murder?
item.description: In 2015, Amanda Antoni was found dead at the bottom of her basement stairs after her husband returned home from a business trip. Investigators ruled it a tragic accident, but a blood-soaked crime scene, unanswered forensic questions, and years of legal battles have left many wondering if the truth was ever uncovered.

item.title: The Fraternity Night That Turned Fatal
item.description: Tim Piazza died after suffering catastrophic injuries during a fraternity pledge event at Pennsylvania State University in 2017. Surveillance footage and the investigation revealed that members delayed calling for help despite his worsening condition. The case led to criminal charges, national outrage, and renewed scrutiny of fraternity hazing across the United States.
